TASK PARTIAL: I got one change drafted but it did not ship, and no listed screen has reached a critic score of 4.

- **Not shipped:** the Run info panel change is ready as `mk-cw-runinfotitle.ps1`. The panel title goes white and its section headings go grey instead of lime. I kept the section headings because the old check 27.42 needs a "RUN GOALS" heading. The new check passes twice on the changed build and fails on the current one, which is the right result.
- **Why it is stuck:** preflight and the real gate both STOPped four times with `RECENT ERROR: dry=TIMEOUT`, with checks 30.12 and 30.10 already red on the current build. Workers 03 and b-02 hit the same STOP, so I don't think my edit causes it. The last two tries stopped with "uncommitted changes" instead. `tools/mkfixture.ps1`, `recent.ps1` and `preflight.sh` have uncommitted edits from someone else.
- **Critic scores:** screens 21 and 50 are both at 2, unchanged since v30.62. The other screens (19, 20, 22–24, 33, 34, 36, 37, 48, 51, 61, 78) have not been run through the critic yet.
- **Next work:** the critic's open findings on screen 50 are:
  - flat vitals bars
  - toast panels
  - a panel behind the top-centre score cluster
  - a smaller ammo panel
- **Next run:** start with `bash S/shipq.sh cw-runinfotitle` (the draft is ready), then work through those findings and re-shoot all 15 screens for the critic.

Everything is in `notes\02-raid-hud-redesign.md`.
